title: Master of Arts in Interreligious Dialogue: Science, Philosophy and Theology of Religions

breadcrumb.label: Master of Arts in Interreligious Dialogue: Science, Philosophy and Theology of Religions

blocks.html:
Recognizing the growing need for individuals with a profound understanding of major world religions and the ability to engage in meaningful interreligious dialogue, the Master of Arts in Interreligious Dialogue: Science, Philosophy and Theology of Religions aims to equip students with the necessary knowledge and skills to contribute to global peace, social cohesion, and effective policymaking.

This programme seeks to cultivate scholars and professionals who can bridge the gaps between different faith traditions and promote mutual respect and cooperation among diverse religious communities. By offering a comprehensive curriculum and different platforms for interdisciplinary dialogue, the Master’s programme is committed to preparing graduates who can actively participate in addressing the challenges and complexities of our contemporary world through interreligious dialogue.
